whenToUse: Titled sections with body copy and footer actions, such as a help notice or a sign in form
Image tiles with a photo above the copy or filling the tile under a dark text overlay
Dashboard widgets such as a KPI with a trend, a usage meter or a deployment or integration status

whenNotToUse.when: A finished grid of KPI tiles, feature links or profile records ready to drop in
A KPI panel with a range filter, a segmented meter or an activity feed beneath it
A preview that pops up over a link while the pointer rests on it

agentNotes: Each example caps `Card` with `max-w-xs`, `max-w-sm` or `max-w-md`; drop the cap when the card should fill a grid cell or column
`size` sm on `Card` tightens padding and gaps in every style; none of these examples sets it, so try it before padding overrides
